CRM-style bullets / call notes:

use_case_summary: PraxisFinder runs a SaaS knowledge-base product for mid-market customers. Need RAG-backed search across product docs, tickets, and warranty PDFs. Focus: embeddings-based retrieval + transformer reranker to elevate precision. Host on Redwood hosted API for speed-to-market; aim to replace current ES+dense_vector setup.
tech_stack_notes: Backend: Node.js + Go microservices; existing vector index: Elastic v8 dense_vector + custom reranker service (PyTorch). Ingest pipeline: hourly batch + realtime ticket streaming. Wants minimal code changes for POC.
additional_reqs: Can tolerate eventual consistency on index updates (<10m). Must support per-tenant data tagging and ability to evict cached entries on doc updates.
sales_notes: Good advocate in Head of Search (E. Russo). Procurement timeline short if POC meets perf/cost. Recommend 2-week hosted POC with 3 workload modes (baseline, batched, cached). Prepare cost model + reserve pricing as uplift option.

renewal_risk_factors: If cost per query not competitive they will re-evaluate open-source self-hosted options
